senses.gloss: m. (זנק), pl. זִיקִין (b. h. sparks, burning arrows (b. h.); meteors, shooting stars [or comet].
a blast of wind, [also imagined as a spirit (cmp. רוּחַ)].
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:3">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite>.—(<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:5">Mikv. IX, 5</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="G00654"><he>זַקָּק</he></cite>.]
